_about: Content kept in data/gloss but left out of (or reworded in) the built app data by scripts/build_data.py, so the shipped text suits young children. Every rule must still match the gloss, or the build fails. See README > Hidden content.

hideSteinsaltz._about: Mishnayos whose Steinsaltz text (stIntro, st, stMore) is dropped. Their pieces then show only the simple meaning, with no Steinsaltz toggle.
hideSteinsaltz.2:5: Steinsaltz spells out consummation on the wedding night.
hideSteinsaltz.3:5: Steinsaltz names seminal emission, and urine and feces.
hideSteinsaltz.3:6: Steinsaltz names seminal emission, semen, menstruation and conjugal relations.

set.en: A zav who also became tamei in another way,

override.why: The simple line named seminal emission.
שִׁכְבַת זֶרַע was glossed word for word as "a layer of seed".
"A woman with her husband" hinted at relations; matches the simple line.
